method: Direct visual inspection of all 12 exported PNG keyframes; exact download hashes verified against curated manifest. All complete videos were separately decoded during the actual harness and registered media GET verification.
scope: Selected start/running/result frames, not a claim that every video frame was visually inspected. Isolated Xvfb displayed only scrubbed terminal output, and all 32 text artifacts passed the private-value/token/credential-URL check before export.
limitations: Long command and test-name lines can extend beyond the terminal viewport; complete commands and output are preserved in the stage JSON and text logs. Core SHA and PASS/count information is fully visible.
Temporary application URLs in immutable documents prove the observed same-origin relationship; their owned app and DB were cleaned up. The offline index displays the archived actual GET bytes.
